SELECT mqce.*, d.id AS 'enclosureTypeDictionary.id', d.label AS 'enclosureTypeDictionary.label', d.value AS 'enclosureTypeDictionary.value' FROM mes_quota_config_enclosure mqce LEFT JOIN sys_dictionary d ON d.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND d.name = 'enclosure_type' AND d.id = mqce.enclosure_type_dictionary_id WHERE mqce.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND mqce.enclosure_type_dictionary_id = #{enclosureTypeDictionaryId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(TRIM(LEADING #{prefix} FROM serial_number) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM mes_quota_config_enclosure WHERE serial_number REGEXP CONCAT('^', #{prefix}, '[0-9]+$')
